fields.System.Title: INB-101 — Create an ASN through the API
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an integration client, I want to create an ASN with its lines, so that receiving
knows what to expect and can check the delivery against it.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a valid supplier and products, when I post an ASN, then it is created with
  • status open and its ID is returned.
  • - Given a product that does not exist, then the ASN is rejected, naming the bad line.
  • - Given a blocked product, then the ASN is accepted with a warning flag on the line.
  • - Given a zero or negative quantity, then it is rejected.
  • - Given a supplier reference already used, then it is rejected as a duplicate.
  • - Given creation succeeds, then an audit row records who created it.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, masterdata |
| Tables | asn, asn_line |
| Risks | Duplicate ASN from an ERP retry ([doc 09 §3.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
